# README artwork

- `lloyal-emblem.png`: the approved Lloyal Labs bracket wordmark on a subtly grained black tile, with the wider, more diffused white halo around all four sides. The glow fades gradually into transparency. The source includes transparent padding; a 190 px image displays the tile at roughly 120 px.
- `fieldnote-overview.png`: the approved illustrated product overview, composed from Fieldnote application and DevTools assets. Its rooftop-solar example replaces the Product Hunt research topic in the initial rendition. It is an illustration, not an unaltered capture of one recorded run.
- `ask.jpg`, `frame.jpg`, `write-searching.jpg`, `settle.jpg`, and `three-agents-one-model.jpg`: original application captures, retained unchanged. The agent timeline appears in the README; the four template stages appear individually in `guides/fieldnote-walkthrough.md`.

Keep the headline, subtitle, navigation, and captions as native README text. The complete masthead mockup is a design reference, not an image to embed. Both new PNG assets have transparent backgrounds for GitHub's light and dark themes.
